classification_policy.adjacent_frame: Report nearest integer-cadence index and residual after the fixed minus-one slot prediction; do not claim an FPGA association from delivered transition pairing.
classification_policy.half_cadence_semantics: Report nearest half-cadence index and residual; a common start/end/centroid convention cancels in pairwise differences and cannot be proved or excluded here.
classification_policy.increment_anomaly: Compare anomaly-class changes with all unchanged-network controls; anomaly occurrence is descriptive and never a timing-based cut.
classification_policy.native_phase: Compare wrapped phase change with measured timing change and the fixed minus-one slot residual; no physical event meaning is assigned to the phase field.

pairwise_formulas.full_cadence_remainder_sec: residual minus nearest integer times 0.008192 sec
pairwise_formulas.half_cadence_remainder_sec: residual minus nearest integer times 0.004096 sec
pairwise_formulas.native_phase_change_sec: wrapped map-B minus map-A phase in [-0.004096, +0.004096) sec

selection_policy: Exact frozen maps, group, and common network IDs only; no result-dependent exclusions.
uncertainty_policy: Pairwise diagonal timing SE is descriptive because cross-map and cross-network covariance is unavailable.
